subject: Acme Logistics — bank proof & remittance mapping for PO onboarding
messages:
From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@acmelogistics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmelogistics.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier docs and bank details for Redwood PO setup

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We're ready to be added as a supplier in your system so we can accept POs and remitments. Please find the required documents attached: our W-9 and a bank confirmation letter on company letterhead signed by our treasury manager.

Bank details (for your routing):
- Bank: Harbor National Bank
- Account name: Acme Logistics LLC
- Routing (ACH): 021000021
- Account (ACH): 123456789
- SWIFT (for wires): HARBUS33

Attachments: w9_acme_2026.pdf, acme_bank_letter_signed.pdf

Please let us know if you need a voided check or micro-deposit verification. We'd like to avoid invoice delays — any estimate for when finance can push test payments/live payments after onboarding?

Thanks,
Sandra Liu
Finance Operations
Acme Logistics
[Attachment: w9_acme_2026.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: acme_bank_letter_signed.pdf (PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com; jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier docs and bank details for Redwood PO setup

Sandra — appreciate the quick turnaround and for sending the bank letter + W-9. A couple of quick items before we can map remittance: 

1) Procurement needs your Vendor Information form filled (I attached our one-page supplier intake to this thread). Can you confirm you returned the intake?
2) Finance (cc'd) will either do a micro-deposit to verify ACH or accept the signed bank letter + voided check if available. Which would you prefer?
3) For remittance emails, do you want remits sent to payments@acmelogistics.com or a different mailbox?

Marissa — if you can confirm receipt of the vendor intake once Sandra returns it, I can kick the PO creation (we'll reference HubSpot DEAL-9012). Jonas, once you confirm the verification route and ETA for first payment it will help set expectations.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

[Procurement intake form: Redwood_Supplier_Intake_1p.pdf (placeholder - not attached)]

From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@acmelogistics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com; procurement@acmelogistics.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier docs and bank details for Redwood PO setup

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — attached is our completed Vendor Information form. We don't have a voided check on file at the moment, so prefer the micro-deposit verification for ACH. Remittance emails should go to payments@acmelogistics.com (cc finance@acmelogistics.com).

If you can create the PO and advise when the micro-deposits will be sent, we'll watch from our side and confirm. Also happy to accept an initial small test wire if that's faster on your end.

Best,
Sandra

[Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Information_Form.pdf (PDF)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com; marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@acmelogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier docs and bank details for Redwood PO setup

All — thanks for the follow-ups. Quick update from Finance: 

- We reviewed the bank letter + W-9; docs are sufficient for initial onboarding.
- We'll perform ACH micro-deposits tomorrow (21 Jan) to the Acme account for verification. Expect two small deposits under $0.50 each; vendor should confirm amounts once they appear.
- Please confirm the PO number you want us to attach to first payment. If Procurement wants a blanket PO for onboarding testing, indicate PO-ONB-9012 and we'll reference that.
- Remittance mapping: we'll add payments@acmelogistics.com as the remittance recipient and include invoice-to PO mapping in the description.

Next steps for Procurement (Karthik/Marissa): create PO-ONB-9012 (or provide desired PO number) and notify Acme so they expect deposits. Once micro-deposits are confirmed, we'll flip the vendor to live payee status and schedule first invoice payment.

Jonas Weber
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Internal note: HubSpot DEAL-9012 linked: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9012]
